name: Altars
overview: Scripture reveals that altars were significant places where God’s people expressed their devotion through sacrifices and calling upon the name of the LORD, as seen in the examples of Noah, Abraham, and Isaac who built altars to offer burnt offerings and worship (Genesis 8:20; 12:7-8; 26:25). These altars marked moments of covenant, obedience, and divine encounter, such as Abraham’s altar where he prepared to sacrifice Isaac in faith (Genesis 22:9). The construction and use of altars were acts of worship that connected the worshiper to God’s promises and presence.
